claims.claim_text: At approximately 0045 hours, I was dispatched to a business at 9196 Bolsa Avenue in the City of Westminster regarding an incident of vandalism.
I arrived on scene at approximately 0055 hours, approximately ten minutes after receiving the dispatch.
He stated the subject had left the area roughly twenty minutes before my arrival.
He was wearing a gray jacket and blue jeans and carrying a metal pole approximately 30 inches long in his right hand.
I drew my service weapon and followed the subject on foot westbound through the alley toward Bolsa Avenue.
Approximately ninety seconds later, Officer Trang arrived at the scene and joined me on foot.
Officer Trang and I gave commands in English only throughout the encounter.
The subject remained non-compliant but walked at a slow, steady pace without any aggressive gestures.
The foot pursuit continued westbound on Bolsa Avenue for approximately two blocks over a period of roughly eight minutes.
He held the pole loosely at waist level. I again commanded the subject to drop the weapon. After a brief pause of approximately fifteen seconds, the subject raised the pole to roughly chest height.
I discharged my firearm two times.
Officer DeSilva immediately moved in and handcuffed the subject, who was conscious but did not speak.
We requested paramedics, who arrived within approximately three minutes.
The subject survived his injuries, which I understand were limited to a wound to his right arm.
I exited my vehicle and ordered the subject to stop, drop the weapon, and sit down. The subject refused all commands and walked westbound away from me.
